name: io.github.subzeroid/hikerapi-mcp
title: HikerAPI
description: Instagram data via HikerAPI: profiles, posts, reels, stories, comments, hashtags, locations.

environmentVariables.name: HIKERAPI_KEY
environmentVariables.description: HikerAPI access key — get one at https://hikerapi.com (100 free requests on signup)

environmentVariables.name: HIKERAPI_TOOLS
environmentVariables.description: core (default): 44 curated tools, one per task. all: every endpoint (100+).
